description: This file defines a class for transforming embedding requests and responses from OpenAI's `/v1/embeddings` API to IBM's WatsonX `/text/embeddings` API route. It includes methods for URL construction, parameter mapping, and response processing specific to WatsonX embeddings.

classes.name: IBMWatsonXEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for transforming embedding requests and responses to IBM WatsonX API format, extending utilities for URL handling and payload preparation.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: AllEmbeddingInputValues, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the request payload for WatsonX's embedding endpoint, including input data and API parameters.

methods.description: Builds and returns the full API URL for the WatsonX embeddings endpoint, incorporating deployment info and API versioning.
